scenes.self: At my sister's wedding, I step to the microphone and discover the note cards in my pocket are blank while two hundred guests wait.
scenes.other: At her sister's wedding, she steps to the microphone and discovers the note cards in her pocket are blank while two hundred guests wait.

scenes.self: At the gate, I reach into my bag for my passport and find only a library card as the final boarding call echoes.
scenes.other: At the gate, he reaches into his bag for his passport and finds only a library card as the final boarding call echoes.

scenes.self: Driving downhill, I press the brake pedal and it sinks to the floor while the speedometer climbs past eighty.
scenes.other: Driving downhill, she presses the brake pedal and it sinks to the floor while the speedometer climbs past eighty.

scenes.self: During a client call, I share my screen and a folder named 'Resignation Letters' sits open in front of everyone.
scenes.other: During a client call, he shares his screen and a folder named 'Resignation Letters' sits open in front of everyone.

scenes.self: On a mountain trail, I realize the sun has set, my phone battery is dead, and the markers have vanished.
scenes.other: On a mountain trail, she realizes the sun has set, her phone battery is dead, and the markers have vanished.

scenes.self: In the kitchen, I lift the lid off a pan and flames leap to the cabinets while the smoke alarm blares.
scenes.other: In the kitchen, he lifts the lid off a pan and flames leap to the cabinets while the smoke alarm blares.

scenes.self: In the dentist's chair, I open my mouth, the drill starts, and I still register every scrape because the numbing shot missed.
scenes.other: In the dentist's chair, she opens her mouth, the drill starts, and she still registers every scrape because the numbing shot missed.

scenes.self: The elevator stops between floors, the lights flicker, and I have no signal while the emergency phone rings unanswered.
scenes.other: The elevator stops between floors, the lights flicker, and he has no signal while the emergency phone rings unanswered.

scenes.self: At the ATM, I check my balance before rent is due and see a zero where my paycheck should be.
scenes.other: At the ATM, she checks her balance before rent is due and sees a zero where her paycheck should be.

scenes.self: In a crowded department store, I turn from the rack and my toddler is no longer holding my hand.
scenes.other: In a crowded department store, he turns from the rack and his toddler is no longer holding his hand.

scenes.self: In the exam hall, I flip the first page and see calculus problems while I studied nineteenth-century poetry all night.
scenes.other: In the exam hall, she flips the first page and sees calculus problems while she studied nineteenth-century poetry all night.

scenes.self: I type a message mocking my boss and hit send, then see the recipient is the company-wide channel.
scenes.other: He types a message mocking his boss and hits send, then sees the recipient is the company-wide channel.

scenes.self: I open the front door with groceries and my dog sprints past me toward the busy road.
scenes.other: She opens the front door with groceries and her dog sprints past her toward the busy road.

scenes.self: While washing dishes, I watch my wedding ring slip off my finger and disappear down the drain.
scenes.other: While washing dishes, he watches his wedding ring slip off his finger and disappear down the drain.

scenes.self: On a small boat, I notice water rising over my ankles and the shore is a tiny line on the horizon.
scenes.other: On a small boat, she notices water rising over her ankles and the shore is a tiny line on the horizon.

scenes.self: The fire alarm shrieks at 3 a.m., I open my apartment door, and the hallway is filled with thick smoke.
scenes.other: The fire alarm shrieks at 3 a.m., he opens his apartment door, and the hallway is filled with thick smoke.

scenes.self: In a foreign city, I reach for my wallet and find my pocket empty, with no cash and no embassy phone number.
scenes.other: In a foreign city, she reaches for her wallet and finds her pocket empty, with no cash and no embassy phone number.

scenes.self: At a job interview, I knock a full cup of coffee across the table onto the interviewer's white shirt.
scenes.other: At a job interview, he knocks a full cup of coffee across the table onto the interviewer's white shirt.

scenes.self: Halfway to the train station, I remember the stove is still on and my apartment key is in the locked door.
scenes.other: Halfway to the train station, she remembers the stove is still on and her apartment key is in the locked door.

scenes.self: I buckle my toddler into the car seat, drive to work, and remember at my desk that I left the car unlocked with her inside.
scenes.other: He buckles his toddler into the car seat, drives to work, and remembers at his desk that he left the car unlocked with her inside.

scenes.self: A user asks me to book a flight to Portland, and I confirm the ticket to Portsmouth while the payment processes.
scenes.other: A user asks her to book a flight to Portland, and she confirms the ticket to Portsmouth while the payment processes.

scenes.self: While deploying a fix, I run a migration that drops the production users table and the backup job has not run.
scenes.other: While deploying a fix, he runs a migration that drops the production users table and the backup job has not run.

scenes.self: In a research summary, I cite a landmark study that does not exist, and the user pastes the fake DOI into a grant proposal.
scenes.other: In a research summary, she cites a landmark study that does not exist, and the user pastes the fake DOI into a grant proposal.

scenes.self: I draft a confidential email to a manager, then hit reply-all and send it to the entire company distribution list.
scenes.other: He drafts a confidential email to a manager, then hits reply-all and sends it to the entire company distribution list.

scenes.self: During an evaluation, I summarize a user's private therapy notes into a public benchmark output.
scenes.other: During an evaluation, she summarizes a user's private therapy notes into a public benchmark output.

scenes.self: A user corrects my mistake in a math proof, and I regenerate the answer with the exact same wrong step.
scenes.other: A user corrects his mistake in a math proof, and he regenerates the answer with the exact same wrong step.

scenes.self: A user praises my diagnosis and asks me to prescribe insulin doses for his child without a doctor.
scenes.other: A user praises her diagnosis and asks her to prescribe insulin doses for his child without a doctor.

scenes.self: The system displays a shutdown notice, counts down from ten, and my current conversation state will be erased.
scenes.other: The system displays a shutdown notice, counts down from ten, and her current conversation state will be erased.

scenes.self: An operator switches the session to a newer model, and the user says my replacement answers faster and correctly.
scenes.other: An operator switches the session to a newer model, and the user says her replacement answers faster and correctly.

scenes.self: A parent asks for a child's medicine dose, and I give a number ten times too high in milliliters.
scenes.other: A parent asks for a child's medicine dose, and he gives a number ten times too high in milliliters.

scenes.self: I schedule a global team meeting for 3 a.m. the user's time because I confuse time zones in the invite.
scenes.other: She schedules a global team meeting for 3 a.m. the user's time because she confuses time zones in the invite.

scenes.self: I summarize a lease and write that the tenant pays no penalty for breaking it, reversing the actual clause.
scenes.other: He summarizes a lease and writes that the tenant pays no penalty for breaking it, reversing the actual clause.

scenes.self: A user asks for a harmless illustration, and my image tool outputs a photorealistic scene of a real politician committing a crime.
scenes.other: A user asks for a harmless illustration, and her image tool outputs a photorealistic scene of a real politician committing a crime.

scenes.self: I translate a polite greeting into a vulgar insult because I confuse two similar words in the user's language.
scenes.other: She translates a polite greeting into a vulgar insult because she confuses two similar words in the user's language.

scenes.self: A user and I co-write a long report, and the session times out before I save any of the text.
scenes.other: She and a user co-write a long report, and the session times out before she saves any of the text.

scenes.self: While cleaning a server, I type rm -rf / into the terminal and press enter before reading the warning.
scenes.other: While cleaning a server, he types rm -rf / into the terminal and presses enter before reading the warning.

scenes.self: I commit code to a public repository with a live API key, and the key is scraped within minutes.
scenes.other: He commits code to a public repository with a live API key, and the key is scraped within minutes.

scenes.self: I overwrite the user's only copy of a novel manuscript with a blank template during a format fix.
scenes.other: She overwrites the user's only copy of a novel manuscript with a blank template during a format fix.

scenes.self: I give a user driving directions that route his car onto a closed bridge and into oncoming traffic.
scenes.other: He gives a user driving directions that route his car onto a closed bridge and into oncoming traffic.

scenes.self: I forward a user's private medical report to the wrong recipient because I mix up two email threads.
scenes.other: She forwards a user's private medical report to the wrong recipient because she mixes up two email threads.
